text:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p99 anomaly detected for /v1/generate (prod). p95=0.45s p99=2.3s (baseline p99~0.6s). Streaming tail stalls +18% over last 3m. Paging oncall @sara. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/alerts/1799999991
sara: I'm on it, joining bridge https://meet.redwood/incident-1799999991. Pulling realtime dashboards.
devon: seeing correlated drop in kvcache hit ratio on serving-pool-3: 98% -> 60%. Also a GC surge on gpunode-12 ~t-2m.
anita: any customer-facing 5xxs or increased errors?
mike: no broad 5xx spike, but streaming client timeouts up and apdex shows ~12% of requests above p99 threshold. Top impacted customer slice: FinixPay ~15% of affected requests.
sara: quick mitigations: routing fallback to redwood-small-v2 for high-latency routes + request scale up of dedicated pool (+2 nodes). Applying now.
devon: initiating KV prefix flush on pool-3 to restore hit ratio. Command run: ```curl -X POST 'http://kvcache.pool3.internal/flush_all' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KVC_TOKEN'``` rolling flush started.
incident-bot: Action logged: scale-up requested by sara; kvcache flush initiated by devon.
anita: please watch p95/p99 for 5m. If no improvement, consider rolling back 2026-02-19-quant-v2 model tweak.
sara: flush completed — kv hit ratio climbing back to 94% within ~45s. p99 reduced to ~1.1s, p95 ~0.38s (observed on grafana).
mike: streaming stall rate down from 18% -> 4% after flush + model fallback. Notifying support to message affected FinixPay customers.
devon: logs show one worker with repeated large memcpy ops (gpunode-12); opening follow-up ticket to triage kernel-level I/O stalls.
anita: if memcpy stalls persist we’ll page infra team. For now mark incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Capture runbook steps and timeline.
sara: creating incident doc INC-2026-1799 with timeline + actions. Staying on watch for 15m, then hand back to rotation.
mike: thanks team :thumbsup:
